description: Goes immediately to the right of a QAR Groove, Probability or Conditional expander that is attached to Quad Algorithmic Rhythm; the shape drawn in its grid replaces that expander's per-step settings.

params.text: Cycles five pinning modes: off; values at or below the pin held at it; those values left where they are while the rest move; values at or above the pin held at it; those left where they are.
Sets the value the pinning modes measure against, 0% to 100% of the grid's range.
Multiplies every grid value by the cosine of the setting, so the shape flattens to nothing halfway round and comes back inverted at the ends.

inputs.text: Voltage raises or lowers every value in the grid at once, 5V for the full range.
Voltage rolls the drawn shape along the 18 steps and wraps it around, 5V for the whole way.
Voltage adds to the pin position, 10V for the full range.
Voltage adds to the grid rotation, 10V for its full travel.

notes: drag across the grid to draw one value per step, 18 in all, which the expander it is attached to uses in place of its own per-step settings.
menu: All Maximum, All Minimum, All Half, Triangle, Sine, Ramp and Random — shapes drawn into the grid; these are on the grid display's own right-click menu, not the panel's.
Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical, Reduce By Half, Shift Left and Shift Right — changes to the shape already drawn; these are on the grid display's own right-click menu, not the panel's.
